market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Under Arne Slot, Liverpool have re-established themselves as a top Premier League side, likely winning the 2024-25 title. Their deep squad, financial strength, and consistency make another top-4 finish very likely. The market price of 52.5% heavily undervalues this probability, which I estimate closer to 75%.
evidence_points: Liverpool are on course to win the 2024-25 Premier League, showing elite performance
Manager Arne Slot has created a cohesive, dominant system with a strong squad
Despite competition from Man City and others, Liverpool's recent record and investment make them a top-4 lock barring a major collapse
sources_consulted: Squad depth and financial analysis (Liverpool top revenue club)
